newsitem.title: GERMANY: German May unadjusted jobless total falls - sources. [CORRECTED 15:42 GMT]
newsitem.headline: German May unadjusted jobless total falls - sources. [CORRECTED 15:42 GMT]

text.p: Pan-German unadjusted unemployment in May fell to 4.256 million from 4.347 million in April, official sources said on Thursday.
The unadjusted unemployment rate was 11.1 percent, compared to 11.3 percent (corrects from 11.06 percent) in April.
The Federal Labour Office is expected to release official figures on Friday at 0800 GMT.
On Wednesday the mass circulation Bild daily reported May unemployment, before seasonal adjustment, fell 91,000 to 4.255 million.
The Berliner Zeitung, another mass circulation daily, reported the number of jobless in May rose by 60,000 when adjusted for seasonal factors.
